text: 15.1 1 Hello, Mr. Gomez. Yes? I'm sorry. Have you been waiting long? About two hours. I'm sorry. We're quite busy today. You've done something to your ankle? Yes. Hmm. It's quite swollen. Does this hurt? Oh! Ow! Yeah. It's very painful. Ah! Can you put any weight on it at all? No, no. It hurts too much. Hmm. And how did you do it? I was just coming out of the hotel, and I slipped on the stair, and my ankle, it just... Ah! Oh, you just fell over on it. Nasty. Well, I think we should have it x-rayed. It might just be badly sprained, but it could be broken. You'll have to wait again, I'm afraid. But I'll give you something for the pain in the meantime. Right. How long will I have to wait for the X-ray? Hopefully it won't be more than half an hour. Are you on any medication? I take something for my asthma. That's fine. Any allergies? No. You've never had any adverse reactions to any drugs? Paracetamol or anything? No. Never. Okay, fine. Well, I'll get the nurse to give you some painkillers and then have you sent down for the X-ray.
